title: A Little Princess
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
intro_zh: 萨拉·克鲁是伦敦寄宿学校的小公主，从云端跌入谷底，靠想象和善良度过最艰难的日子。
intro_en: Sara Crewe, a privileged pupil at a London boarding school, loses everything but her kind heart.

chapters.title: Sara Crewe
chapters.body: Sara Crewe was eight years old when she came to live at Miss Minchin's school. Her father, Captain Crewe, brought her from India. She had a doll named Emily. She was rich, and everyone was kind to her.

chapters.title: A French Lesson
chapters.body: Sara stood at the blackboard. She wrote the French words. She made a mistake. She did not cry. She was brave.

chapters.title: The Diamond Mines
chapters.body: Captain Crewe told Sara about the diamond mines. They were in India. One day he would take her there. Sara was very happy.
